changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add stainless steel as a distinct active material without changing the existing steel entry.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO material (code, material_group, active) VALUES ('STAINLESS_STEEL', 'CASE', true) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET material_group = EXCLUDED.material_group, active = EXCLUDED.active;
INSERT INTO material_i18n (material_id, lang, name) SELECT material.id, translation.lang, translation.name FROM material CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('ru', 'Нержавеющая сталь'), ('kk', 'Тот баспайтын болат'), ('en', 'Stainless steel') ) AS translation(lang, name) WHERE material.code = 'STAINLESS_STEEL' ON CONFLICT (material_id, lang) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name;
